node.label: Geography, Places & Disasters
node.summary: Cyclones, weather, and places in the news.

facts.text: An avalanche on the **Kedartal** trek (**Uttarkashi**, Uttarakhand) left eight missing (two bodies found); permits for treks above **4,000 m** were suspended.
facts.plain: An avalanche on the Kedartal trek (Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand) left eight missing (two bodies found); permits for treks above 4,000 m were suspended.

facts.text: Cyclones in the north Indian Ocean are named from a list prepared by the **WMO/ESCAP Panel on Tropical Cyclones** (13 member countries); the **IMD** (Regional Specialised Meteorological Centre, **New Delhi**) assigns the names in turn.
facts.plain: Cyclones in the north Indian Ocean are named from a list prepared by the WMO/ESCAP Panel on Tropical Cyclones (13 member countries); the IMD (Regional Specialised Meteorological Centre, New Delhi) assigns the names in turn.

facts.text: Severe cyclonic storm **Murasu** crossed the coast near **Ongole** (Prakasam district, A.P.) on 3 Nov at 110-120 km/h: **2 deaths**, crops on **52,459 ha** hit, losses put at **₹344 crore**; Guntur, Bapatla and Palnadu worst hit. It came a week after Cyclone **Arnab**.
facts.plain: Severe cyclonic storm Murasu crossed the coast near Ongole (Prakasam district, A.P.) on 3 Nov at 110-120 km/h: 2 deaths, crops on 52,459 ha hit, losses put at ₹344 crore; Guntur, Bapatla and Palnadu worst hit. It came a week after Cyclone Arnab.

facts.text: **Apure** (Venezuela), **Dammam** (Saudi Arabia), **Kherson** and **Oleshky** (Ukraine): sites of attacks in the world news.
facts.plain: Apure (Venezuela), Dammam (Saudi Arabia), Kherson and Oleshky (Ukraine): sites of attacks in the world news.

facts.text: **Jhunjhunu** (Rajasthan): eight labourers electrocuted when a machine touched an 11-kV line.
facts.plain: Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan): eight labourers electrocuted when a machine touched an 11-kV line.

facts.text: **Ravva oilfield**: offshore in the **Krishna-Godavari basin**, Andhra Pradesh (Vedanta arbitration).
facts.plain: Ravva oilfield: offshore in the Krishna-Godavari basin, Andhra Pradesh (Vedanta arbitration).

facts.text: Meghalaya got only **38.3 mm** of rain in October against a normal of 255 mm, an **85%** deficit; the monsoon deficit was 60%.
facts.plain: Meghalaya got only 38.3 mm of rain in October against a normal of 255 mm, an 85% deficit; the monsoon deficit was 60%.

facts.text: Disaster response chain: IMD warnings, State evacuation, NDRF (a statutory force under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**).
facts.plain: Disaster response chain: IMD warnings, State evacuation, NDRF (a statutory force under the Disaster Management Act, 2005).

facts.text: Tamil Nadu sent **500** electricity staff in 25 teams to restore power in Andhra Pradesh.
facts.plain: Tamil Nadu sent 500 electricity staff in 25 teams to restore power in Andhra Pradesh.

facts.text: **Cyclone Arnab** forced the evacuation of **1.6 lakh** people in Odisha.
facts.plain: Cyclone Arnab forced the evacuation of 1.6 lakh people in Odisha.

facts.text: **Cyclone Murasu** made landfall between **Ongole and Nellore** (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h; NDRF deployed 14 teams.
facts.plain: Cyclone Murasu made landfall between Ongole and Nellore (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h; NDRF deployed 14 teams.

facts.text: India's 2026 southwest monsoon ended nearly **13% below the long-term average** (87 cm) — the driest season on record (since 1901) for East and Northeast India — despite IMD's April forecast of 92% of the Long Period Average; of seven Indian monsoons since 1950 that coincided with a moderate/strong El Nino, five (including 2026) saw rainfall at least 10% below average, while 1997 was a rare exception because a favourable Indian Ocean Dipole phase offset El Nino's effect; the monsoon supplies about three-quarters of India's annual rainfall and roughly 40% of farmland remains unirrigated.
facts.plain: India's 2026 southwest monsoon ended nearly 13% below the long-term average (87 cm) — the driest season on record (since 1901) for East and Northeast India — despite IMD's April forecast of 92% of the Long Period Average; of seven Indian monsoons since 1950 that coincided with a moderate/strong El Nino, five (including 2026) saw rainfall at least 10% below average, while 1997 was a rare exception because a favourable Indian Ocean Dipole phase offset El Nino's effect; the monsoon supplies about three-quarters of India's annual rainfall and roughly 40% of farmland remains unirrigated.

facts.text: Delhi CM **Rekha Gupta** announced a 3.3-km heritage corridor along Netaji Subhash Marg from Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate, covering the Red Fort, St James' Church and Chandni Chowk, with a Heritage Interpretation Park planned at Delhi Gate.
facts.plain: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta announced a 3.3-km heritage corridor along Netaji Subhash Marg from Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate, covering the Red Fort, St James' Church and Chandni Chowk, with a Heritage Interpretation Park planned at Delhi Gate.

facts.text: **Cyclone Murasu** was expected to make landfall on Tuesday between Nellore and Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h, days after **Cyclone Arnab** killed five, submerged 3.5 lakh hectares of crops, damaged 2,425 km of roads and ~15,000 electric poles, and caused an estimated ₹4,600 crore in losses; AP put five districts (SPSR Nellore, Prakasam, Guntur, Bapatla, Krishna) on red alert and mobilised 1,688 medical teams and 116 relief camps.
facts.plain: Cyclone Murasu was expected to make landfall on Tuesday between Nellore and Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h, days after Cyclone Arnab killed five, submerged 3.5 lakh hectares of crops, damaged 2,425 km of roads and ~15,000 electric poles, and caused an estimated ₹4,600 crore in losses; AP put five districts (SPSR Nellore, Prakasam, Guntur, Bapatla, Krishna) on red alert and mobilised 1,688 medical teams and 116 relief camps.

facts.text: A low-pressure area over the South Andaman Sea was expected to intensify into a depression and a cyclone over the southeast **Bay of Bengal**; A.P. CM Chandrababu Naidu ordered ₹54,000/hectare compensation for coconut damage from the earlier cyclone.
facts.plain: A low-pressure area over the South Andaman Sea was expected to intensify into a depression and a cyclone over the southeast Bay of Bengal; A.P. CM Chandrababu Naidu ordered ₹54,000/hectare compensation for coconut damage from the earlier cyclone.

facts.text: The Pacific Ocean was named 'Mar Pacifico' by **Ferdinand Magellan**; the International Date Line passes between Big and Little Diomede islands in the Bering Strait.
facts.plain: The Pacific Ocean was named 'Mar Pacifico' by Ferdinand Magellan; the International Date Line passes between Big and Little Diomede islands in the Bering Strait.

facts.text: Odisha: a landslide at Dangeshi village (Raikia block, **Kandhamal**) killed three; post-Cyclone Arnab floods hit 84,564 people in Ganjam, Gajapati and Kandhamal; ₹4 lakh aid per death.
facts.plain: Odisha: a landslide at Dangeshi village (Raikia block, Kandhamal) killed three; post-Cyclone Arnab floods hit 84,564 people in Ganjam, Gajapati and Kandhamal; ₹4 lakh aid per death.

facts.text: A **glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF)** in **Bhutan** put north Bengal's Darjeeling hills and **Dooars** on alert; 4,000+ people were moved in **Kumargram** and **Tufanganj** as the **Sankosh** river rose.
facts.plain: A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) in Bhutan put north Bengal's Darjeeling hills and Dooars on alert; 4,000+ people were moved in Kumargram and Tufanganj as the Sankosh river rose.

facts.text: Andhra Pradesh relief for Cyclone Arnab: **₹5 lakh** ex gratia per death, ₹25,000/ha input subsidy, ₹18,000/ha for aquaculture ponds; 12,500 trees fell in West Godavari; the **Coconut Board** will help revive plantations.
facts.plain: Andhra Pradesh relief for Cyclone Arnab: ₹5 lakh ex gratia per death, ₹25,000/ha input subsidy, ₹18,000/ha for aquaculture ponds; 12,500 trees fell in West Godavari; the Coconut Board will help revive plantations.

facts.text: Renaming a State needs a law of **Parliament under Article 3** (on the President's recommendation, after seeking the State legislature's views); it is not a constitutional amendment under Article 368. The Kerala Assembly had passed resolutions seeking 'Keralam'.
facts.plain: Renaming a State needs a law of Parliament under Article 3 (on the President's recommendation, after seeking the State legislature's views); it is not a constitutional amendment under Article 368. The Kerala Assembly had passed resolutions seeking 'Keralam'.

facts.text: Kerala now goes by **'Keralam'** — the State 'added an m to its name', as *The Hindu* noted; the paper now uses Keralam throughout.
facts.plain: Kerala now goes by 'Keralam' — the State 'added an m to its name', as The Hindu noted; the paper now uses Keralam throughout.

facts.text: Cyclone Arnab's rain flooded south Odisha: **Patrapur (Ganjam)** recorded **546 mm** in 24 hours; NH-326 (Berhampur-Mohana) was washed away; 42,500 people marooned in Ganjam; the **Rushikulya, Vansadhara and Mahendratanaya** rivers were in spate; the Coast Guard used an **ALH Mk-III** helicopter.
facts.plain: Cyclone Arnab's rain flooded south Odisha: Patrapur (Ganjam) recorded 546 mm in 24 hours; NH-326 (Berhampur-Mohana) was washed away; 42,500 people marooned in Ganjam; the Rushikulya, Vansadhara and Mahendratanaya rivers were in spate; the Coast Guard used an ALH Mk-III helicopter.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu's Secretariat functions from **Fort St. George**, Chennai; the TVK government has proposed a new Secretariat near the coast. The DMK's 2010 complex on Anna Salai is now the Omandurar hospital.
facts.plain: Tamil Nadu's Secretariat functions from Fort St. George, Chennai; the TVK government has proposed a new Secretariat near the coast. The DMK's 2010 complex on Anna Salai is now the Omandurar hospital.

facts.text: Andhra CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu** put Cyclone Arnab losses at **₹4,600 crore** and seven deaths; **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema** district was worst hit (8,000 poles uprooted); ₹1,500 per fallen coconut/oil palm tree; a low-pressure area over the south Andaman Sea was expected to become a depression.
